Name: The Overflowing Graveyard
GimmickText: Follow the lit lantern from yard to yard. The terraces and gates are yours to learn.
Description: Where every reaping begins. Walled yards, a chapel on the hill and a horde that never stops.

Name: The Drowned Harbour
GimmickText: The TIDE rises every minute: the flats flood, slow you and drown the horde. Hold the boardwalks at high tide.
Description: Quays and boardwalks over tidal flats. Farm the flats at low tide, run for high ground when it turns.

Name: The Clocktower
GimmickText: The map is a clock face: JUMP the sweeping hands (they flatten the horde). Every 30s TIME STOPS for 4 seconds.
Description: The Merchant's lair, built up a hillside. The lantern trail only climbs.
